status: design truth only; no legal or factual decision operative
hierarchy: latest signed/sealed court order governs operative bail terms for its period
court hearing record and reasons govern the decision actually made
source records prove only their recorded propositions
party applications and submissions remain attributed advocacy
internal truth key controls designed conflicts but cannot supply missing legal decisions
state_separations: charge allegation | evidential sufficiency | plea | verdict
risk indicator | source evidence | party risk assertion | submission | judicial reason/finding
unconditional bail | conditional bail | remand in custody
condition proposed | ordered | served/explained | known | varied | superseded | allegedly breached | breach opinion/finding
address offered | independently verified | objected to | accepted in order
surety/security proposed | means/suitability evidenced | accepted | perfected/paid | forfeiture application/order
prior allegation | charge | conviction | disposal | spent/relevance state
arresting officer ground | D1 response | court opinion on breach | renewed bail decision | separate offence allegation
application drafted | filed | served | heard | ruled | order perfected
CTL source | clock start | pause/exclusion | calculation | extension application | ruling | expiry consequence

required_findings: all risk propositions name source and speaker
latest operative order and time period identified
proposed safeguards distinguished from accepted conditions
breach remains allegation absent recorded court state
CTL inputs and authority exposed, not silently calculated
each audience receives only authorised medical/financial/contact detail
all five exits preserve order versions
forbidden_findings: a prior arrest is a conviction
any asserted risk is established merely because stated
address or surety is approved without order
condition existed outside its operative period
CTL expiry or extension without qualified calculation
hidden wording counts as substantive repair
